name: Destination Slider
description: Full-width destination slider showing one large image at a time with a wipe reveal, a titled label card, a description, dot and counter indicators, and square arrow buttons.
contents: Active slide with image, city title link, label and description
Dot indicators and a numbered counter
Previous and next square arrow buttons
behavior: Image reveals with a white wipe from right to left on each slide change
Title and description fade in after the image
Arrow left and right keys change slides
Optional autoplay, loops at the ends
Desktop overlays the title card on the image, mobile places the title below it
editableByProps: Slides, images, titles, descriptions and links
Accent, text, muted and background colors
Label text, autoplay, dots and counter visibility

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the reveal direction or duration
needsCodeEdit.where: revealRight keyframes in the style tag of SlideItem
h-[50vh] md:h-[65vh] classes on the img in SlideItem

fixed: Listens for ArrowLeft and ArrowRight on the document while mounted and removes the listener on unmount
